name: OpenKB
uses: CLI and local workbench that compiles documents into an interlinked Markdown wiki of summaries, concept and entity pages, flags contradictions, and retrieves without a vector database.
features: compile PDFs, Office, Markdown, HTML and URLs to a wiki
local PageIndex tree indexing, no vector database
next_gate: Trial under $PFY_TMP on a 30-entry slice of sources/entries with the local default model: answer ten known catalog questions from the compiled wiki versus plain grep, scoring accuracy and wall time. No cloud provider, no PAGEINDEX_API_KEY, no skill symlinks into real agent homes, workbench on loopback only. No Feature GO.
non_goals: skill symlinks into real agent homes
